description: Company growth signal: is a company growing or cutting? From our recorded history of every posting added and removed on its public job board (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: open roles now, added and removed per week, net change and growth rate over 7 and 30 days, teams and locations growing or shrinking, new roles, remote share, ATS and careers page, and a one-line summary. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base via x402.
